cultural.vision_reason: The photo shows a Gwari (Gbagyi) woman carrying a large woven basket of sticks on her shoulder, wearing a head-cloth and neck-ornament—an authentic documentary image of the claimed people's daily life and material culture (basketry, dress).

physical.title: photographic print
physical.summary:
Nigeria, three-quarter profile, head and shoulders portrait of Gwari adult female carrying basket full of sticks on shoulder. Basket has pointed bootom, balanced in cracked pot. Female wearing head-cloth, neck-ornament.
Medium: Gelatin silver print.
Format: One of four prints mounted on album page.




. Small group of adult females and a child, sitting on ground outdoors. Wearing personal-ornaments including disc-shaped lip-plugs and ear-plugs, bowl-shaped hair-styles. Two females dressing hair of other two females, using small pointed tools. Female at right holding young child.
Medium: Gelatin silver print.
Format: One of four prints mounted on album page.
